meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 为项目接入 Matrix 频道：从 channels 分支复制并注册适配器、安装 @beeper 适配器包、打 ESM 补丁并构建；随后需为机器人单独注册 Matrix 账号并写入凭据。
howto.when: 当你要给项目添加 Matrix 频道支持时触发；若正处于 /setup 流程中，完成后需返回该流程继续。

say.text: 给项目加上 Matrix 频道，复制适配器并构建
say.note: 会执行 Apply 里的复制、注册、安装和构建步骤

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 凭据写进 .env
用 access token 方式配置 Matrix 机器人账号
say.note: 写入 MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN，而非用户名密码

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support: copies and registers the adapter from the channels branch, installs the @beeper adapter package, patches ESM imports, builds, then needs a separate bot account with credentials.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Matrix channel to the project; if you are in the middle of /setup, return to the setup flow afterwards.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel: copy the adapter and build.
say_en.note: Runs the copy, register, install and build steps.
Asks for homeserver URL, bot user ID and display name.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot account with an access token.
